task_title: RFC3339 timestamps on the queue API endpoints
task_criteria: Every started_at/completed_at returned by GET /api/v1/queue and GET /api/v1/queue/{submission_id} parses with time.Parse(time.RFC3339, v) (verified live against a scratch instance; no raw 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' text survives to the wire).

A pending queue entry returns started_at and completed_at as empty strings, matching the documented examples in docs/api-reference.md, and no raw store string is assigned to the wire struct (entryToWire routes both fields through an RFC3339 formatter).

A regression test in internal/api/handlers_test.go fails on the unfixed code and passes after the fix; gofmt, go build ./..., go vet ./..., go test ./... -short -p 1 -count=1 and gitreins guard are green.
